{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I have had a se'neth. I have spoken of the storm to you before. I have seen it again, but this time I have watched the wind more carefully. The great storm will wash over us all, but I see now that it rages in the stars as well as in the sky. The dark storm clouds will reach our world, but they do not come from here.|Mother Dariana, speaking to Tarasin leaders in the Home of Wisdom|<ref name="Home of Wisdom">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040325wisdom|text=Home of Wisdom|int=Home of Wisdom (article)}}</ref>}}
Among the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Home of Wisdom" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]],<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> a '''se'neth''' was a term given to a dream considered to constitute a vision. Se'neth were rare and were believed to foretell significant events.<ref name="Home of Wisdom" />
 
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]], a Tarasin leader of the [[Hiironi irstat]], experienced a se'neth indicating that a great storm would soon spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] but would not originate on Cularin. Dariana summoned other Tarasin leaders to the [[Home of Wisdom (Cularin)|House of Wisdom]], a revered Tarasin meeting place sited in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of Cularin, to discuss her se'neth.<ref name="Home of Wisdom" />
